name: Snatch / hit-empty-deck
notes: CR1.6.2c: a hit queues the draw layer, which grants a response window before drawing. Printed Snatch blue: cost 0, power 2, no go again; draw exactly one card only on a hit. Defense 0 gives 2 damage. Empty deck means the attempted draw adds no card, while the hit still occurs.
